items.title_zh: CARE：为扩散模型引入条件感知的表征正则化
items.title_en: CARE: Condition-Aware Representation Regularization for Diffusion Models
items.summary_zh: 该论文指出，扩散模型中常用的表征正则化方法往往忽略了标签、文本等内建条件，而这些条件恰恰直接决定生成目标。作者先分析条件信号如何影响特征分布，进而提出 CARE（Condition-Aware REpresentation regularization），一种轻量级、可即插即用的正则化框架，能够动态调制表征。该方法的卖点在于不改变现有模型结构即可提升样本质量与训练效率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28561v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in diffusion models highlight the importance of representation regularization for improving sample quality and training efficiency. However, commonly used regularization methods often overlook the built-in conditions (such as labels or texts) which directly determine the generation target. In this work, we demonstrate how conditioning signals affect the feature distribution and introduce the CARE (Condition-Aware REpresentation regularization). CARE is a lightweight plug-and-play regularization framework that dynamically modulates…
items.why_zh: 为扩散模型提供了一种通用、低成本的正则化改进思路，可直接嵌入现有训练流程。
items.why_en: It offers a generic, low-cost regularization improvement for diffusion models that can be dropped into existing training pipelines.

items.title_zh: 面向316L不锈钢氢脆检测的防泄漏机器学习：SEM图像的纹理与深度特征区域留出评估
items.title_en: Leakage-Safe Machine Learning for Hydrogen Embrittlement Detection in 316L Stainless Steel: A Region-Held-Out Evaluation of Texture and Deep Features in SEM Micrographs
items.summary_zh: 论文针对结构钢氢脆（HE）研究中用扫描电镜（SEM）图像自动表征时常见的数据泄漏问题：当多张图像来自同一样品区域时，按图像划分训练集与测试集会让信息在两者间泄漏，导致评估结果虚高。作者提出“区域留出”协议，对316L不锈钢的原始态（AR）与充氢态（H2）SEM图像进行分类，并基于留一区域等方式评估纹理特征与深度特征的表现。该协议旨在让氢脆检测的机器学习评估更贴近真实泛化能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28567v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) is routinely used to characterize the microstructural changes caused by hydrogen embrittlement (HE) in structural steels. Machine learning can automate this characterization, but models are often evaluated using image-level splits. When several images come from the same specimen region, such splits leak information between the training and test sets. Here, we propose a region-held-out protocol for classifying as-received (AR) and hydrogen-charged (H2) SEM micrographs of 316L stainless steel, based on Leave-One-R…
items.why_zh: 揭示了材料图像机器学习中普遍存在的划分泄漏问题，并给出更可靠的评估协议。
items.why_en: It exposes a common leakage pitfall in materials-image machine learning and offers a more reliable evaluation protocol.

items.title_zh: 可审计性并非单一属性：强化学习中的规则重叠、行为一致性与组合
items.title_en: Auditability Is Not One Property: Rule Overlap, Behavioural Agreement, and Composition in Reinforcement Learning
items.summary_zh: 论文关注强化学习策略通常以不透明的神经网络检查点形式分发、而训练日志只能证明“训练发生过”却说不清策略学到了什么的问题，研究能否用可审计的离散行为规则来表示和组合独立训练的策略。作者将可审计性拆解为六个可分别检验的谓词：轨迹完整性、无损编码、规则覆盖率、行为一致性、组合质量与价值模型可靠性，并采用共享的冻结符号化器与被动规则抽取方法构建协议。该框架让 RL 策略的可解释性与可验证性从模糊概念变为可逐项测量的指标。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28581v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement-learning (RL) policies are often distributed as opaque neural checkpoints, while training logs show that a run occurred without explaining what the policy learned. We study whether independently trained policies can be represented and composed through auditable discrete behavioral rules. We define auditability as six separately testable predicates: trace integrity, lossless coding, rule coverage, behavioral agreement, composition quality, and value-model reliability. Our protocol uses a shared frozen symbolizer, passive rule extract…
items.why_zh: 把强化学习策略的可审计性拆成可测量的具体指标，为 RL 安全与监管提供可操作的评估框架。
items.why_en: By breaking RL auditability into measurable predicates, it offers an actionable framework for safety and oversight of RL policies.

items.title_zh: SGA：时间序列基础模型多步预测的不确定性量化
items.title_en: SGA: Uncertainty Quantification for Multi-Step Forecasting in Time Series Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的出现显著提升了多步预测性能，使模型能在较长未来区间上给出较准确的预测；但这类模型往往带有显著的内在不确定性，其典型表现是每个时间步都会衍生出多条预测分支并向后续步骤传播，而不同分支的预测表现差异明显，从而削弱了 TSFM 预测结果的可信度。针对这一问题，作者提出了名为 SGA 的方法（摘要给出的方法全名被截断），专门面向 TSFM 的多步预测开展不确定性量化。该工作聚焦于让长时程预测更可靠、更可解释。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recent emergence of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) has significantly advanced multi-step forecasting performance, enabling accurate predictions over extended future horizons. However, existing TSFMs often suffer from significantly inherent uncertainty, which typically manifests as derived forecast branches emerging at each time step and spreading to subsequent steps; different forecast branches often exhibit varying forecasting performance, thereby undermining the credibility of TSFM forecasts. In this paper, we propose the Slicing-Gra…
items.why_zh: 为时间序列基础模型的长时程预测提供不确定性度量，是其在高风险场景中落地的前提。
items.why_en: Quantifying uncertainty is a prerequisite for deploying time-series foundation models in high-stakes forecasting.

items.title_zh: RLVR 在迭代乘法上的优化地形可能是良性的：来自自旋玻璃理论的启示
items.title_en: RLVR landscapes for iterated multiplications can be benign: Insights from spin-glass theory
items.summary_zh: 尽管可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）十分重要，但它究竟能在多大程度上让模型习得新的推理能力，仍存在争议。作者研究了 RLVR 在迭代群乘法、拟群乘法等算法任务上的优化地形，做法是把针对短视表格策略的熵正则化 RLVR 映射为确定性策略上的能量模型，即自旋玻璃模型。该映射给出了 RLVR 能够达到效果的上界，并使作者能够在表格设定下严格刻画优化地形；其结论是这类地形可能是良性的。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28625v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Despite the importance of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), the extent to which it can learn new reasoning capabilities remains debated. Here we study the optimization landscape of RLVR on algorithmic tasks, such as iterated group and quasigroup multiplication. To this end, we map entropy-regularized RLVR over myopic tabular policies onto an energy-based (spin-glass) model over deterministic policies. This mapping upper-bounds what RLVR can achieve, and lets us rigorously characterize the landscape in this tabular setting. We…
items.why_zh: 为“RLVR 能否学到新推理能力”这一争议提供了可严格分析的理论工具。
items.why_en: It offers a rigorous theoretical handle on the debate over whether RLVR instills new reasoning capabilities.

items.title_zh: 超越静态图世界模型：在演化拓扑上学习随机隐动态
items.title_en: Beyond Static Graph World Models: Learning Stochastic Latent Dynamics over Evolving Topologies
items.summary_zh: 基于图的世界模型近来被用于在关系型状态表示上学习状态转移，但现有方法大多局限于固定拓扑的图，或确定性的全可观测环境。作者提出图动态模型（GDM），这是一种面向图结构观测的世界模型，能够处理拓扑不断演化、且环境随机且部分可观测这一更一般的设定。GDM 使用稀疏的循环邻接矩阵来建模拓扑更新并完成记忆相关建模（摘要此处被截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28670v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph-based world models have recently emerged as a means of learning transitions over relational state representations. However, existing approaches are largely limited to fixed-topology graphs or deterministic, fully observable environments. We propose the Graph Dynamics Model (GDM), a world model for graph-structured observations that is designed to handle the more general setting of evolving topologies in stochastic and partially observable environments. The GDM uses a sparse recurrent adjacency matrix to model topology updates and perform me…
items.why_zh: 让世界模型能应对拓扑随时间变化且状态部分可观测的真实场景，是迈向通用图世界模型的一步。
items.why_en: It extends world models toward realistic settings where graph structure changes and observations are partial.

items.title_zh: 思考泄漏：混合推理模型 NoThink 后训练的因果审计
items.title_en: Thinking Leakage: A Causal Audit of NoThink Post-Training in Hybrid Reasoning Models
items.summary_zh: 以 NoThink 模式对混合推理模型进行后训练，因能在保持推理速度的同时提升表现而受到越来越多关注；但这些收益可能来自基础模型 Think 模式下本已可获得的思考行为。作者将这种“思考泄漏”形式化为因果中介框架，并沿一条由基础模型导出的激活方向进行双向干预，以审计其贡献。在竞赛数学基准上、针对三个模型和三种后训练方法的实验发现，这种泄漏确实存在且具有因果性（摘要后续内容被截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Post-training hybrid reasoning models in NoThink mode has attracted growing interest as a way to improve performance while keeping inference fast. However, these gains may draw on thinking behavior already accessible through the base model's Think mode. We formulate this thinking leakage in a causal mediation framework and audit its contribution using bidirectional interventions along a simple base-derived activation direction. Across three models and three post-training methods on competition math benchmarks, we find that leakage is real, causal…
items.why_zh: 它提示 NoThink 后训练的收益可能只是“搬运”了已有思考能力，影响对这类训练方法的评估。
items.why_en: It cautions that claimed gains from NoThink post-training may not reflect genuinely new reasoning ability.

items.title_zh: 评估小波扩散降水降尺度的跨区域泛化能力
items.title_en: Evaluating Cross-region Generalization for Wavelet-Diffusion Precipitation Downscaling
items.summary_zh: 扩散模型在公里级降水降尺度方面展现出很强的潜力，但其在地理上未曾见过的区域以及不同事件类型下的表现仍缺乏充分理解。作者基于小波扩散模型（WDM）框架，评估其跨区域与跨事件的泛化能力，选取美国六个 3°×3° 区域，覆盖对流性、冬季、热带和大气河等降水类型。低分辨率输入通过对 NOAA 多雷达/多传感器（MRMS）组合反射率数据进行块平均生成（摘要后续内容被截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28749v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion models have shown strong potential for kilometer-scale precipitation downscaling, but their performance in geographically unseen regions and event regimes remains insufficiently understood. Building on the wavelet diffusion model (WDM) framework, this study evaluates cross-region and cross-event generalization. Six 3 x 3 deg U.S. regions represent convective, winter, tropical, and atmospheric-river precipitation regimes. Low-resolution inputs are generated by block averaging NOAA Multi-Radar/Multi-Sensor (MRMS) composite reflectivity fi…
items.why_zh: 泛化能力决定了降水降尺度模型能否真正应用于未观测地区。
items.why_en: Generalization determines whether downscaling models can be trusted in unobserved regions.

items.title_zh: 用分布式声波传感与深度学习精细监测城市交通动态
items.title_en: Monitoring Urban Traffic Dynamics at Fine Spatiotemporal Resolution Using Distributed Acoustic Sensing and Deep Learning
items.summary_zh: 以高时空分辨率刻画交通动态分布，是交通研究中的一个基础性问题。分布式声波传感（DAS）作为一种新兴的地震观测手段，有望实现实时城市交通监测：它把地下既有的光纤电缆改造成密集、连续的传感器阵列，从而对道路上的交通活动进行被动且保护隐私的监测，具备米级空间分辨率和秒级时间分辨率。作者将 DAS 与深度学习结合，探索城市交通动态的精细监测方法（摘要后续内容被截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28793v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mapping the distribution of traffic dynamics at high spatiotemporal resolution is a fundamental question in transportation research. Distributed acoustic sensing (DAS), an innovative seismic observation tool, emerges as a promising solution for real-time urban traffic monitoring at high spatial and temporal scales. Distributed acoustic sensing repurposes existing underground fiber-optic cables as dense, continuous sensor arrays, enabling passive and privacy-preserving monitoring of roadway traffic activity at meter-level spatial and second-level…
items.why_zh: 复用既有光纤实现低成本、隐私友好的高分辨率交通监测，具备现实部署价值。
items.why_en: It repurposes existing fiber infrastructure for low-cost, privacy-preserving, high-resolution traffic sensing.

items.title_zh: 带电子先验的响应态学习：面向可迁移的振动光谱表征
items.title_en: Response-state Learning for Transferable Vibrational Spectroscopic Characterization with Electron Prior
items.summary_zh: 当局部立体电子环境扰动中间响应态、且高风险响应单元主导特征光谱指纹时，振动光谱预测会变得不准确，使得向外部化学空间的迁移预测变得困难。作者提出 SO(3) 等变神经卡尔曼网络（SENK），构成一个响应态级联结构：用等变 Transformer 骨干学习 Hessian、偶极导数和极化率导数，再用等变神经卡尔曼桥进行状态相关的精化与可靠性建模（摘要后续内容被截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28935v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vibrational spectral prediction can become inaccurate when localized stereoelectronic environments perturb intermediate response states and high-risk response units dominate characteristic spectral fingerprints, making prediction across external chemical space difficult. SO(3) Equivariant Neural Kalman Networks (SENK) form a response-state cascade that combines an equivariant transformer backbone for Hessian, dipole-derivative and polarizability-derivative learning, an Equivariant Neural Kalman bridge for state-dependent refinement and reliabilit…
items.why_zh: 面向振动光谱的等变模型有望提升跨化学空间的迁移预测能力。
items.why_en: It aims at more transferable spectroscopic characterization across unseen chemical space.

items.title_zh: 基于 Hermite 多项式的谱图神经网络：一项综合研究
items.title_en: Spectral Graph Neural Networks with Hermite Polynomials: A Comprehensive Study
items.summary_zh: 作者研究了以 Hermite 多项式构建的谱图神经网络，并提出简单模型 HermNet：它把逐节点预测器与归一化 Hermite 传播结合起来，其稀疏递推既不需要特征分解，也不需要学习基。文中区分了基础模型与可选的坐标校准、响应归一化和高斯导数正则化。研究指出，Hermite 与其他完备多项式基张成相同的有界阶滤波器空间，但在特定条件下它们的坐标可能导致不同的优化行为（摘要后续内容被截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28979v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study spectral graph neural networks built from Hermite polynomials and propose HermNet, a simple model that combines a nodewise predictor with normalized Hermite propagation. Its sparse recurrence requires neither eigendecomposition nor a learned basis. We distinguish the basic model from optional coordinate calibration, response normalization and Gaussian derivative regularization. Hermite and other complete polynomial bases span the same degree-bounded filter space, but their coordinates can produce different optimization behavior under lim…
items.why_zh: 它说明多项式基的选择会改变谱图神经网络的优化行为，为设计更简单高效的模型提供依据。
items.why_en: It shows the choice of polynomial basis affects optimization in spectral GNNs, informing simpler designs.

items.title_zh: BranchShine-CR：紧凑多语言 IPA 转写模型，自条件 CTC 加一致性正则
items.title_en: BranchShine-CR: Compact Multilingual IPA Transcription with Self-Conditioned CTC and Consistency Regularization
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出 BranchShine-CR，一个仅 2500 万参数的多语言国际音标（IPA）转写模型。模型融合 log-mel 特征、带旋转位置编码的 E-Branchformer 编码器、中间层自条件连接时序分类（CTC）以及针对增强视图的一致性正则。在 16,646 条共享 IPApack++ 测试语音上，其 IPA 字符错误率为 4.47%，相比 ZIPA-CTC-NS 相对降低 22.3%，而参数量约为后者的十二分之一，且为从零开始训练。这表明在语音转写任务中，通过结构设计与训练策略可以同时压缩模型并提升精度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29069v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce BranchShine-CR, a 25M-parameter model for multilingual transcription into the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA). It combines log-mel features, a rotary-position E-Branchformer encoder, intermediate self-conditioned connectionist temporal classification (CTC), and consistency regularization across augmented views. On 16,646 shared IPApack++ test utterances, it achieves 4.47% IPA character error rate, a 22.3% relative reduction from ZIPA-CTC-NS, with approximately one-twelfth as many parameters while being trained from scratch. Bra…
items.why_zh: 它以约十二分之一的参数量取得更低的 IPA 转写错误率，说明紧凑模型也能在多语言音标转写上兼顾效率与准确度。
items.why_en: It shows a compact, from-scratch model can beat a much larger baseline on multilingual IPA transcription, improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

items.title_zh: 面向流场的物理与数据驱动 Transformer-Mamba 框架
items.title_en: Physics and Data Driven Transformer-Mamba Framework for Flow Field
items.summary_zh: 针对计算流体力学（CFD）中求解偏微分方程代价高昂的问题，论文指出 PINN、FNO 等现有深度学习方法在泛化能力、噪声鲁棒性和物理一致性方面常显不足。作者提出 TM4FF（Transformer-Mamba for Flow Field）框架，这是一种带物理约束的算子学习模型，包含三项关键设计：用于特征去噪的残差小波 Mamba（RWM）层、用于增强特征融合的 Transformer 注意力机制，以及采用傅里叶算子的物理信息损失（摘要在此处截断）。该工作尝试把数据驱动与物理约束结合，以提升流场预测的可靠性与一致性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29087v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While deep learning accelerates expensive partial differential equation solving in computational fluid dynamics (CFD), existing methods like PINNs and FNOs often struggle with generalization, noise robustness, and physical consistency. We introduce the Transformer-Mamba for Flow Field (TM4FF) framework, a physics-constrained operator learning model with three key innovations: a Residual Wavelet Mamba (RWM) layer for feature denoising, a Transformer-based attention mechanism for enhanced feature fusion, and a physics-informed loss using Fourier de…
items.why_zh: 它把 Mamba、Transformer 与物理约束结合，试图解决 CFD 代理模型泛化差、抗噪弱、物理不一致的长期痛点。
items.why_en: It combines Mamba, attention, and physics constraints to tackle the long-standing weaknesses of CFD surrogate models in generalization, noise robustness, and physical consistency.

items.title_zh: 延迟与修订结果下的下行受控在线预测组合
items.title_en: Downside-Controlled Online Forecast Combination under Delayed and Revised Outcomes
items.summary_zh: 论文研究对无法重新训练的预测器（如基础模型）做事后校正的问题：在误差稳定的场景上拟合出的校正，可能在误差分布变化时反而有害。作者提出“下行控制”目标，即结果不应明显差于原始预测，方法是在单纯形上组合冻结的预测器、静态校正器与在线校正器，且仅使用在预测时域结束后才成熟的损失。在七个基准、四个基础模型（其中两个为基础模型）的实验中，28 组配对在主时域上的最差退化仅为 0.15%，收益最高可达 11.5%。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29096v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Post-hoc correction adjusts a forecaster that cannot be retrained, such as a foundation model, but a correction fitted where errors are stable can hurt where they shift. We aim for downside control: not much worse than the starting forecast. We combine the frozen forecaster, a static corrector and an online corrector on the simplex, using only losses that mature after the horizon. Across seven benchmarks and four base models, two of them foundation models, the worst deterioration over 28 pairs at the main horizon is 0.15% and gains reach 11.5%. O…
items.why_zh: 它给“不可再训练的预测器”提供了一种几乎不会变差、上不封顶的事后校正方案，对部署基础模型做预测很实用。
items.why_en: It offers a post-hoc correction scheme for non-retrainable forecasters that is nearly guaranteed not to hurt performance while still delivering gains, which is practical for deployed foundation models.

items.title_zh: MORE-PLR：用多输出回归求解偏序标签排序
items.title_en: MORE-PLR: multi-output regression employed for partial label ranking
items.summary_zh: 偏序标签排序（partial label ranking）是一种监督学习场景，目标是为给定输入实例预测定义在标签集合上的桶序（bucket order），即允许并列的偏好排序，它推广了只能输出全序的经典标签排序问题。现有方法主要是把标签排序方法扩展以处理预测中的并列情况。本文提出用多输出回归来解决偏序标签排序，并引入了相应的方法设计（摘要在此处截断）。该思路把偏好预测转化为多目标回归问题，为处理并列偏好提供了不同的建模路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29386v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The partial label ranking problem is a supervised learning scenario that aims to fit a preference model that predicts a bucket order defined over a set of labels for a given input instance. This problem generalizes the well-known label ranking problem, which, in practice, is limited to outputting total orders of labels. Existing partial label ranking methods have primarily extended label ranking approaches to handle ties in predictions. This paper proposes using multi-output regression to address the partial label ranking problem, introducing an…
items.why_zh: 它用多输出回归这一常见工具替代传统的标签排序扩展思路，为允许并列的偏好预测提供了新的建模框架。
items.why_en: It reframes tie-aware preference prediction as multi-output regression, offering an alternative modeling framework to conventional label-ranking extensions.

items.title_zh: ICE：面向多模态图基础模型的任务对齐 Clifford 隐场
items.title_en: ICE: Task-Aligned Clifford Latent Fields for Multimodal Graph Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 多模态属性图把实体、视觉内容、语言和观测关系连接在一起。论文指出，在这类图上学习一个统一的基础模型，远不只是把每个节点压缩成一个融合的欧氏向量：表示必须保留实体语义、从图邻域构造交互状态，并把这些状态暴露给几何结构不同的预测单元。作者的经验研究表明这些需求彼此不可分割，高阶通道可以恢复基础图之间的成对关系，而专门设计的查询能揭示更多信息。基于此，论文提出 ICE——任务对齐的 Clifford 隐场方法，用于多模态图基础模型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29398v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal attributed graphs connect entities, visual content, language, and observed relations. Learning one foundation across such graphs requires more than compressing each node into a fused Euclidean vector. The representation must preserve entity semantics, construct interaction state from graph neighborhoods, and expose that state to prediction units with different geometry. Our empirical study shows why these requirements are inseparable. Higher-grade channels recover pair relations across the foundation graphs, specialized queries reveal…
items.why_zh: 它主张多模态图基础模型的表示必须保留几何结构而非简单融合成欧氏向量，为图基础模型设计提供了新视角。
items.why_en: It argues that multimodal graph foundation models must preserve geometric structure rather than fuse everything into Euclidean vectors, offering a new design perspective.

items.title_zh: SPADE-DFL：基于无导数线性化 ADMM 的通信高效去中心化联邦学习
items.title_en: SPADE-DFL: Communication-Efficient Decentralized Federated Learning via Derivative-Free Linearized ADMM
items.summary_zh: 论文关注无导数去中心化学习中的通信开销问题，指出降低通信的关键在于控制多次本地更新之间累积的不一致。作者提出 SPADE-DFL，一种原始—对偶方法，允许相邻节点交换之间执行的本地函数值更新次数随计算预算增长，同时保持非隐私情形下的收敛阶。对于满足一致查询矩界的光滑非凸目标，所给的非隐私调度可达到时间平均的稳定性与一致性界为 O(T^{-1/3})（摘要在此处截断）。该工作试图在去中心化、无梯度设定下同时兼顾通信效率与收敛保证。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29446v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reducing communication in derivative-free decentralized learning requires controlling the disagreement accumulated over multiple local updates. This paper develops SPADE-DFL, a primal--dual method that allows the number of local function-value updates between neighbor exchanges to grow with the computation budget while preserving the nonprivate convergence order. For smooth nonconvex objectives under uniform query-moment bounds, the prescribed nonprivate schedule achieves a time-averaged stationarity and consensus bound of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/3})$…
items.why_zh: 它在无导数、去中心化的联邦学习设定下给出了可随计算预算放宽本地更新次数的收敛保证，直击通信瓶颈。
items.why_en: It provides convergence guarantees while allowing more local updates per communication round in derivative-free decentralized learning, directly addressing the communication bottleneck.

items.title_zh: BLADE：用蒸馏 LLM 正则化实现校准的知识图谱补全
items.title_en: BLADE: Distilled LLM Regularization for Calibrated Knowledge Graph Completion
items.summary_zh: 知识图谱补全模型通常以排序为目标进行优化，但许多下游应用需要的是校准后的概率。论文提出 BLADE，一种变分模型，将潜在真值与图谱记录过程分离，并把离线语言模型判断蒸馏进一个冻结的教师正则器中；推理阶段不再需要 LLM。其后验采样可给出预测概率与认知不确定性，而紧凑的教师模型只作为可选的筛选因子存在。在五个基准上，BLADE 在统一评价标准下保持了竞争力（摘要在此处截断），兼顾了校准性与补全效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29487v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Knowledge graph completion models optimize ranking, although many downstream applications require calibrated probabilities. We present BLADE, a variational model that separates latent truth from graph recording and distills offline language-model judgments into a frozen teacher regularizer. The LLM is absent during inference. Posterior samples provide predictive probabilities and epistemic uncertainty, while the compact teacher remains available only as an optional triage factor. Across five benchmarks, BLADE remains competitive under a common ra…
items.why_zh: 它让知识图谱补全输出可校准的概率与不确定性，同时把昂贵的 LLM 留在训练阶段，兼顾可靠性与推理成本。
items.why_en: It delivers calibrated probabilities and uncertainty for knowledge graph completion while keeping the expensive LLM out of inference, balancing reliability and cost.

items.title_zh: 多任务学习的样本加权端到端迹范数几何
items.title_en: Sample-Weighted End-to-End Trace-Norm Geometry for Multitask Learning
items.summary_zh: 多任务模型由共享表示与任务专属输出组成，但现有的泛化界往往分别控制这两个部分。论文指出，这种做法可能忽略相对方向与抵消效应，并且在中间坐标的等价变换下发生变化，即便所表示的预测器本身并未改变。作者转而研究从任务系数到输入空间预测器的端到端映射的、按样本量加权的迹范数，并为该固定半径类推导出精确的经验 Rademacher 复杂度（摘要在此处截断）。这一视角把共享表示与任务输出作为一个整体来刻画泛化能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29520v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multitask models combine a shared representation with task-specific outputs, but generalization bounds often control the two components separately. Such products can discard relative orientation and cancellation and can change under equivalent transformations of intermediate coordinates even when the represented predictors are unchanged. We study instead the sample-size-weighted trace norm of the end-to-end map from task coefficients to input-space predictors. For its fixed-radius class, we derive the exact empirical Rademacher complexity. The sa…
items.why_zh: 它指出分别控制共享表示与任务输出会丢失方向与抵消信息，并提出端到端迹范数这一更合理的泛化刻画方式。
items.why_en: It shows that controlling shared and task-specific components separately discards orientation and cancellation effects, proposing an end-to-end trace-norm view of multitask generalization.

items.title_zh: 面向强化学习中成本敏感语言模型指导的“建议预测价值”认证门控
items.title_en: Certified Predictive Value-of-Advice Gating for Cost-Aware Language-Model Guidance in Reinforcement Learning
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文关注强化学习中调用语言模型给出建议的代价问题：调用昂贵，且返回的动作可能过时或错误。作者把“是否获取建议”建模为一个与响应相关的元推理问题——在查询之前，控制器先预测可能被解析出的各种响应，评估每种响应将导致的决策及后续走向，只有当预测价值的下置信界超过定价成本时才发起查询。执行阶段则由针对具体动作的证书单独管控。论文在明确假设下给出了认证性结论（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language-model advice can accelerate reinforcement learning, but calls are costly and returned actions may be stale or wrong. We formulate advice acquisition as a response-contingent metareasoning problem: before querying, the controller predicts possible parsed responses, evaluates the decision and declared continuation that would follow each response, and queries only when a lower confidence bound on predictive value exceeds the priced cost. Execution is governed separately by an action-specific certificate. Under explicit assumptions, certifie…
items.why_zh: 它把“何时值得调用语言模型”变成可认证的成本—收益判定，为昂贵 LLM 指导的强化学习提供了理论化的门控机制。
items.why_en: It turns when to call an LLM into a certifiable cost-benefit decision, offering a principled gating mechanism for costly language-model guidance in RL.

items.title_zh: 从纵向文本数据建模组织层面“语义身份”的计算框架
items.title_en: A Computational Framework for Modelling Organisation-Level Semantic Identity from Longitudinal Textual Data
items.summary_zh: 组织持续产生大量文本数据，记录其如何沟通、演变并形成差异化。尽管 NLP 进展显著提升了组织层面的文本分析能力，但现有方法主要把组织表示为潜在嵌入或预测性特征向量，用于相似度估计、分类或检索。作者因此指出，目前尚不存在一个通用计算框架，能够把组织层面的“语义身份”本身作为建模对象。该论文提出这样一个框架（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29584v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Organisations continuously generate large volumes of textual data that capture how they communicate, evolve and differentiate themselves over time. Although recent advances in natural language processing have substantially improved organisation-level text analytics, existing approaches primarily represent organisations as latent embeddings or predictive feature vectors for similarity estimation, classification or retrieval. Consequently, there is currently no general computational framework for modelling organisation-level semantic identity as an…
items.why_zh: 它把“组织是谁”而非“组织像什么向量”作为建模目标，为长期追踪组织身份演化提供了新的分析范式。
items.why_en: It targets modelling what an organization is, rather than just its embedding, offering a new paradigm for tracking how organizational identity evolves over time.

items.title_zh: 公共教育预测基准的结构可靠性有限：对七个数据集的四维度审计
items.title_en: Limited Structural Reliability in Public Educational Prediction Benchmarks: A Four-Dimension Audit of Seven Datasets
items.summary_zh: 研究者对七个公共教育预测数据集进行了建模前的四维度可靠性审计。结果只有三个数据集通过全部检查，其余四个要么未通过群体感知的泛化测试，要么缺少运行这些测试所需的来源（provenance）元数据。其中一个数据集最初被判定为不合格，但在把群体标识类特征从留出矩阵中剔除后被更正，说明该审计能区分真正的跨群体混杂与特征编码造成的人为假象。审计所用检查包括基线差距等项目，且均在模型优化之前完成。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29625v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Across seven public educational prediction datasets, three passed all four pre-modeling reliability checks; the remaining four either failed group-aware generalization tests or lacked the provenance metadata needed to run them. One dataset was initially classified as failing but corrected after excluding group-identifier features from the holdout matrix, demonstrating that the audit can distinguish genuine cross-group confounding from feature-encoding artifacts. Each dataset was audited before model optimization using four checks: baseline gap, s…
items.why_zh: 它提示教育预测研究中广泛使用的公开基准可能存在结构性缺陷，直接影响基于这些数据得出的结论可信度。
items.why_en: It warns that widely used public educational prediction benchmarks may be structurally flawed, undermining confidence in conclusions drawn from them.

items.title_zh: 持续学习中的“顺序代价”
items.title_en: The Sequential Price of Continual Learning
items.summary_zh: 顺序任务更新是持续学习的核心，但其对近期任务的偏好会带来持久的性能损失。作者在过参数化线性回归模型、任务独立同分布采样的设定下研究这一代价，证明分布层面的遗忘与总体损失会收敛到同一个平稳极限。该共同极限可精确分解为联合训练渐近可达到的“内在损失”，以及额外的“顺序代价”；在任务几何更同质的条件下，两项趋于一致，总损失随之翻倍（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29674v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sequential task updates are fundamental to continual learning, but their recency bias can impose a lasting performance cost. We study this cost in an overparameterized linear-regression model with i.i.d. task sampling. We prove that distribution-level forgetting and population loss converge to the same stationary limit. This common limit separates exactly into the intrinsic loss asymptotically attained by joint training and an additional sequential price, and in more homogeneous task geometries the two terms coincide, making the total loss twice…
items.why_zh: 它把持续学习中“顺序训练带来的额外损失”从经验现象提升为可精确分解的理论量。
items.why_en: It turns the extra loss caused by sequential training in continual learning from an empirical symptom into an exactly decomposable theoretical quantity.

items.title_zh: Bandit 多类 PAC 学习：修正的下界、精确类别族与置信度直和现象
items.title_en: Bandit Multiclass PAC Learning: Corrected Lower Bounds, Exact Families, and a Confidence Direct-Sum Phenomenon
items.summary_zh: 论文研究带 bandit 反馈的可实现多类 PAC 学习：学习器看到独立同分布样本后预测 K 个标签之一，但只能得知预测是否正确。此前 Hanneke、Meng、Moran 与 Shaeiri 用 bandit DS 维数在上对数因子意义下刻画了最优样本复杂度，并提问是否每个类别都具备 O((BDS+log(1/δ))/ε) 的样本复杂度。本文首先指出已发表的下界 Ω((BDS+log(1/δ))/ε) 存在问题，进而给出修正结果、精确的类别族刻画，以及一种“置信度直和”现象（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study realizable multiclass PAC learning with bandit feedback: the learner observes an i.i.d. instance, predicts one of $K$ labels, and learns only whether the prediction was correct. Hanneke, Meng, Moran, and Shaeiri (arXiv:2605.25678) characterized the optimal sample complexity via the bandit DS dimension $\mathrm{BDS}$ up to logarithmic factors, and asked whether every class admits sample complexity $O((\mathrm{BDS}+\log(1/\delta))/\epsilon)$. First, we show that the published lower bound $\Omega((\mathrm{BDS}+\log(1/\delta))/\epsilon)$ is…
items.why_zh: 它纠正了 bandit 多类学习最优样本复杂度刻画中的一处下界错误，并细化了可达与不可达类别的边界。
items.why_en: It corrects an erroneous lower bound in the characterization of optimal sample complexity for bandit multiclass learning and sharpens the boundary between achievable and unachievable classes.

items.title_zh: 利用碰撞时间与过街区域上下文的城市交叉口行人轨迹安全预测
items.title_en: Safety-oriented pedestrian trajectory prediction at urban intersections using time-to-collision and crossing-zone context
items.summary_zh: 准确的行人轨迹预测对主动道路安全应用至关重要，城市交叉口尤其如此——行人运动同时受车辆交互与过街位置影响。本研究提出一个面向安全的轨迹预测框架，把行人运动历史与碰撞时间（TTC）信息和过街区域指示变量结合起来。作者使用 inD（Intersection Drone）数据集中某城市交叉口的自然驾驶/自然轨迹数据，在 1.6 秒的设定下评估了多种神经网络架构（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29706v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate pedestrian trajectory prediction is important for proactive road-safety applications, particularly at urban intersections where pedestrian motion is shaped by both vehicle interactions and crossing context. This study presents a safety-oriented trajectory-prediction framework that combines pedestrian motion history with Time-to-Collision (TTC) information and crossing-zone indicators. Using naturalistic trajectories from one urban intersection in the inD (Intersection Drone) dataset, several neural architectures were evaluated with 1.6 s…
items.why_zh: 它把安全指标（TTC）与场景语义（过街区域）直接注入轨迹预测，使预测更贴合主动道路安全需求。
items.why_en: It injects safety metrics (TTC) and scene semantics (crossing zones) directly into trajectory prediction, making forecasts more useful for proactive road safety.

items.title_zh: 经典测验理论误导 LLM 评判者的三种方式
items.title_en: Three Ways Classical Test Theory Misleads for LLM Judges
items.summary_zh: 当用 LLM 评判者按评分标准给一批回答打分时，可靠性系数可能报出 0.52，但这个数字究竟测量了什么？论文指出，评判者评估正越来越多地借用经典测验理论的可靠性统计量，却往往不说明每个统计量所假定的测量设计；而由于评判者场景重新安排了这些设计所依赖的角色分工，三种被广泛套用的统计量对评判者与对测验的含义并不相同。例如，在评分标准要素上计算内部一致性系数时并不包含评分者面（facets）——摘要在此处截断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29709v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An LLM judge scores a bank of responses against a rubric, and the reliability comes back at $0.52$. What has been measured? Judge evaluation has begun borrowing reliability statistics from classical test theory, usually without stating the measurement design each statistic assumes, and we show that three widely portable ones mean something different for a judge than for a test because the judge setting rearranges the roles those designs rest on. First, an internal-consistency coefficient computed over rubric elements contains no scorer facet. Hol…
items.why_zh: 它提醒研究者：直接套用心理测量学的可靠性数字来评判 LLM 评判者，可能得到被误读的结论。
items.why_en: It warns that naively applying psychometric reliability numbers to LLM judges can yield badly misread conclusions.

items.title_zh: 分布漂移下，科学代理模型靠“重新验证”胜过有状态路由
items.title_en: Revalidation Beats Stateful Routing for Scientific Surrogates Under Distribution Shift
items.summary_zh: 代理模型常在开发阶段选定，之后随着新测量数据到来而被一直沿用；当噪声、输入支撑范围或物理参数发生变化时，这种做法就有风险。作者追问：这类变化究竟需要一个有状态的、自适应控制器，还是只需在每个新批次上重新验证候选模型即可。为回答该问题，他们构建了可复现的流式基准 RegimeShift-Surrogates，覆盖八项解析与动力学任务、四种平稳或漂移机制、十个留出随机种子以及八种（方法）类别，结论是重新验证优于有状态路由。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29715v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Surrogate models are often chosen during development and then left in place as new measurements arrive. That practice becomes risky when noise, input support, or physical parameters change. We asked whether such changes call for a stateful adaptive controller, or whether it is enough to validate the candidate models again on each new batch. To study this question, we built RegimeShift-Surrogates, a reproducible streaming benchmark spanning eight analytic and dynamical tasks, four stationary or shifting regimes, ten held-out seeds, and eight class…
items.why_zh: 它用一个可复现的流式基准表明，简单的批次级重新验证往往就足以应对漂移，无需复杂的自适应路由。
items.why_en: A reproducible streaming benchmark indicates that simple per-batch revalidation often suffices under distribution shift, without complex adaptive routing.

items.title_zh: SwitchPFN：以共享切换动态实现冻结式上下文时间序列分类
items.title_en: SwitchPFN: Shared Switching Dynamics for Frozen In-Context Time Series Classification
items.summary_zh: 论文探讨表格基础模型（TFM）用于时间序列分类时的表示设计问题。作者指出，现有做法面临两难：全局聚合会丢失时间演化的顺序信息，而在各自独立拟合的坐标系中计算出的特征，在不同序列间含义并不一致。为此，他们把表示设计本身当作一个独立问题，提出 SwitchPFN，要求所构造的表示既能保留局部时间转移信息，又能在冻结（不做微调）的上下文学习设定下工作。摘要原文在此处截断，具体方法细节以原文为准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29814v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) provide a promising route to time-series classification, but their effectiveness depends on how sequential data are converted into tabular representations. Existing representations face two challenges: global aggregation can lose the order of temporal evolution, while features computed in independently fitted coordinate systems may not have consistent meanings across sequences. We therefore view representation design for TFMs as a problem in its own right: the representation should preserve local temporal transiti…
items.why_zh: 它把“如何把序列转成表格”从工程细节提升为核心研究问题，可能影响基础模型在时间序列任务上的表现上限。
items.why_en: It reframes sequence-to-table conversion as a first-class research problem, potentially raising the ceiling of foundation models on time-series tasks.

items.title_zh: 追踪状态还是追踪陪集？学习式状态追踪的代数解释
items.title_en: Tracking States or Tracking Cosets? An Algebraic Account of Learned State Tracking
items.summary_zh: 状态追踪要求模型把一连串更新复合起来，但仅凭准确率无法看出模型究竟学到了什么。作者训练神经网络预测群元素序列的连乘积，并在 Transformer 中发现了“商解”：模型只恢复了商类，却在该类的各个成员之间近乎均匀地预测。他们还发现，类大小的倒数可以在不拟合任何参数的情况下预测部分准确率，从而把此前基于奇偶性（parity）的解释推广到非奇偶商。摘要还提到基线 Transformer 的预测在前缀重排下变化很小，原文在此处截断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29951v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: State tracking requires composing a sequence of updates, but accuracy alone does not reveal what a model has learned. We study neural networks trained to predict the running product of group elements. We identify quotient solutions in Transformers, where models recover the quotient class while predicting nearly uniformly among its members. The reciprocal of class size predicts partial accuracy without a fitted parameter, extending parity-based accounts to non-parity quotients. Our baseline Transformers' predictions change little under prefix reor…
items.why_zh: 它揭示准确率指标会掩盖模型真正学到的结构，为理解和评估神经状态追踪提供了代数视角。
items.why_en: It shows accuracy can hide what a model actually learns, offering an algebraic lens for understanding and evaluating neural state tracking.

items.title_zh: 让训练指导筛选：以真实数据为锚的在线合成数据过滤
items.title_en: Let Training Guide Selection: Online Synthetic Data Filtering via Real-Anchored Utility
items.summary_zh: 当真实数据有限时，合成数据可以扩充监督信号，但噪声与分布不匹配会削弱其价值。现有的合成数据筛选方法多强调保真度或多样性，而忽视了学习者在训练过程中的动态需求。作者提出 FROST：一个在线框架，利用以真实训练数据为锚的梯度反馈来估计合成样本的效用。它把当前批次的效用与近期历史做校准，据此判断何时需要过滤，并只在“超出正常区间”的批次中筛选样本，以决定过滤哪些样本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29988v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Synthetic data can scale training supervision when real-world data are limited, but noise and distribution mismatch can reduce its value. Existing synthetic data selection methods often emphasize fidelity or diversity rather than the learner's evolving needs. We propose FROST, an online framework that estimates synthetic-data utility through gradient feedback anchored in real training data. It calibrates batch utility against recent history to determine when filtering is needed and filters samples only in out-of-band batches to determine what to…
items.why_zh: 它把合成数据筛选从静态打分变为随训练动态调整的在线决策，有望提升数据稀缺场景下的训练效率。
items.why_en: It turns synthetic-data selection from static scoring into a training-time online decision, potentially improving efficiency when real data are scarce.

items.title_zh: Canopy：利用分段平滑树先验的多保真度赌博机
items.title_en: Canopy: Exploiting Piecewise Smooth Tree Priors for Multi-Fidelity Bandits
items.summary_zh: 许多 LLM 推理问题都可视为在树上的优化，例如模型路由、前缀缓存管理、提示词裁剪与测试时搜索；这种结构源自自回归生成——每个前缀定义一个节点，其续写构成下层子树。树的内部节点提供廉价但有偏差的区域价值估计，叶子节点评估昂贵却准确。分层赌博机方法可以利用该结构，但通常要求事先给定特定的平滑度日程。Canopy 借助分段平滑的树先验来应对这一问题，原文摘要在此处截断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many LLM inference problems, including model routing, prefix-cache management, prompt trimming, and test-time search, can be viewed as optimization over a tree. This structure arises naturally from autoregressive generation: every prefix defines a node, and its continuations form a subtree below it. Internal nodes of the tree provide cheap but biased estimates of a region's value, while leaf evaluations are expensive but accurate. Hierarchical bandit methods can exploit this structure, but typically require a specific smoothness schedule to be sp…
items.why_zh: 它为 LLM 推理中的树状决策问题提供了可降低评估成本的结构化优化思路。
items.why_en: It offers a structured way to cut evaluation cost in tree-shaped LLM inference decisions.

items.title_zh: 面向含节点与边特征的图神经网络的可达性形式化验证
items.title_en: Reachability-Based Formal Verification of Graph Neural Networks with Node and Edge Features
items.summary_zh: GNN 已成为电力系统中构建快速、拓扑感知代理模型的重要方法，支持潮流（PF）分析、最优潮流（OPF）估计和连锁故障分析（CFA）等任务。然而，对基于 GNN 的模型进行形式化验证仍然困难，现有方法的适用范围有限。作者通过 GraphStar 集合把神经网络验证（NNV）框架扩展到图结构输入：GraphStar 是 Star 集合的推广，能够刻画节点与边特征上的不确定性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30079v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have become a prominent approach for developing fast, topology-aware surrogates in electric power systems, supporting tasks such as power flow (PF) analysis, optimal power flow (OPF) estimation, and cascading failure analysis (CFA). Despite this growing use, formally verifying GNN-based models remains challenging, with existing methods limited in scope. We extend the neural network verification (NNV) framework to graph-structured inputs through GraphStar sets, a generalization of Star sets that captures uncertainty ov…
items.why_zh: 它为电力系统等安全关键场景中 GNN 代理模型的可信部署补上了形式化验证的一环。
items.why_en: It adds a formal verification step needed for trusting GNN surrogates in safety-critical domains such as power systems.

items.title_zh: 信还是不信：语音场景下的检索增强事实核查
items.title_en: To Trust or Not to Trust: Retrieval-Augmented Fact Checking in Speech
items.summary_zh: 网络虚假信息越来越多以语音形式出现，例如新闻片段、播客、访谈、政治演讲和社交媒体视频，因此需要能够直接从语音中核实主张的事实核查系统。作者提出 VeriSpeak，一个用于研究大型音频语言模型（LALM）语音事实核查能力的探针基准。该基准包含 3,879 条口语主张，覆盖时间、地理和关系类事实，真假标签数量均衡，用于考察模型能否完成事实核验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.30227v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Online misinformation increasingly appears in spoken formats such as news clips, podcasts, interviews, political speeches, and social media videos, creating a need for fact-checking systems that can verify claims directly from speech. We introduce VeriSpeak, a probe benchmark for studying speech-based fact verification in Large Audio Language Models (LALMs). VeriSpeak contains 3,879 spoken claims spanning temporal, geographical, and relational facts, with balanced true and false labels. The benchmark is designed to examine whether factual verific…
items.why_zh: 它为评估音频大模型能否核实口语主张提供了标准化的探针基准。
items.why_en: It provides a standardized probe for evaluating whether large audio language models can verify spoken claims.

items.title_zh: 带自适应加权与效率评估的混合变分量子-经典框架
items.title_en: Hybrid Variational Quantum-Classical Framework with Adaptive Weighting and Efficiency Assessment
items.summary_zh: 混合量子-经典神经网络被视为在现有硬件限制下把量子计算用于机器学习的一条有前景路径。论文提出 Sim-HVQC：一种混合深度量子神经网络，把自适应、无参数的 SimAM 加权模块与经典特征提取相结合，在编码进变分量子电路（VQC）之前保留具有类别判别力的信息。作者指出以往研究局限于二分类，而所提方案试图突破这一限制，原文摘要在此处截断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28491v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hybrid quantum-classical neural networks have emerged as a promising approach for leveraging quantum computing in machine learning while mitigating current hardware limitations. This paper presents Sim-HVQC, a hybrid Deep Quantum Neural Network that couples an adaptive, parameter-free SimAM weighting module with classical feature extraction to preserve class-discriminative information prior to encoding into a Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC). Previous studies are restricted to binary classification [1] [2] [3] [4] [5]. In contrast, the propose…
items.why_zh: 它尝试用无参数注意力式加权提升量子电路编码前的特征质量，并把混合量子模型从二分类推向更广的任务。
items.why_en: It uses parameter-free attention-style weighting to improve features before quantum encoding, pushing hybrid quantum models beyond binary classification.

items.title_zh: 面向覆盖率约束的共形模型选择的序贯置信集
items.title_en: Sequential Confidence Sets for Coverage-Constrained Conformal Model Selection
items.summary_zh: 现代共形预测系统往往同时维护多条自适应流水线，它们在基础预测器、共形分数、校准窗口和更新规则上各不相同。比较这些流水线并不容易：覆盖率是硬约束，而效率只能在可行流水线之间优化。作者把该问题表述为随机约束 argmin 的序贯推断，在每个时刻，目标是满足多个前缀平均条件误覆盖约束的最低成本流水线集合，并据此提出相应方法（原文摘要在此截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28522v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern conformal forecasting systems often maintain several adaptive pipelines that differ in base forecasters, conformity scores, calibration windows, and update rules. Comparing them is difficult because coverage is a hard constraint, whereas efficiency should be optimized only among feasible pipelines. We formulate this problem as sequential inference for a stochastic constrained argmin. At each time, the target is the set of minimum-cost pipelines satisfying multiple prefix-average conditional miscoverage constraints. We introduce Coverage-…
items.why_zh: 它把“在保证覆盖率的前提下挑最省成本的预测流水线”变成一个有置信度保证的序贯决策问题。
items.why_en: It turns cost-efficient pipeline selection under coverage guarantees into a sequential decision problem with confidence guarantees.

items.title_zh: 随机性大模型评测新方法：用分层贝叶斯策略降低方差
items.title_en: Speculative Evaluation of Stochastic LLMs
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注一个被忽视的评测难题：大语言模型的输出具有随机性，基准分数只是多次随机采样后的期望表现估计，而均匀重复采样忽略了不同任务之间采样方差差异巨大的事实。作者在固定采样预算下，研究如何最小化基准均值的方差，并提出“推测式评测”（Speculative Evaluation）方法，配合分层贝叶斯 Neyman（HBN）策略，在事前就联合确定试验规模与各阶段权重。该方法先跑一轮短时间的均匀试验，再用分层贝叶斯模型汇总各任务的成功计数，从而把更多预算分配到高方差任务上。对依赖昂贵随机采样的模型评测而言，这有望在同等成本下给出更稳定、更可信的结论。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28560v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Evaluating a stochastic large language model is costly: benchmark scores estimate expected performance from randomized rollouts, yet uniform repetition ignores sharp differences in task-level rollout variance. We ask how to minimize the variance of a fixed-benchmark mean under an exact rollout budget. We develop Speculative Evaluation with a Hierarchical Bayesian Neyman (HBN) policy with pilot size and stage weight jointly chosen ex ante. It runs a short uniform pilot, pools per-task success counts with a hierarchical Bayesian model, and uses p…
items.why_zh: 它直面随机采样评测中“同预算、不同方差”的核心矛盾，有望让昂贵的大模型基准测试更省成本也更可靠。
items.why_en: It tackles the core tension of variance across tasks in randomized LLM benchmarking, potentially making costly evaluations cheaper and more reliable.

items.title_zh: 别把日志给评审看：执行轨迹会污染视频生成智能体的验证器
items.title_en: Don't Read the Log: Execution Traces Contaminate Verifiers in Video-Generation Agents
items.summary_zh: 智能体式视频生成系统形成了“生成器—验证器”闭环：LLM 规划镜头、调用文生视频模型，多模态裁判再判断结果是否满足需求。为定位长流程中的失败环节，近期的一些评测框架会刻意向裁判展示超出视频本身的信息——包括智能体的执行轨迹、计划以及它合成的旁白。本文提出的问题是：在画面帧保持完全不变的前提下，这些附加文本是否会影响裁判对纯视觉要求的判定？作者基于包含 109 个生成的双事件片段的基准展开研究，结果显示执行轨迹等辅助信息会“污染”验证器判断。这提示研究者与工程团队在设计评测流程时需警惕此类信息泄漏带来的偏差。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28564v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agentic video-generation systems close a loop between a generator and a verifier: an LLM plans shots, calls a text-to-video model, and a multimodal judge decides whether the result satisfies the request. To diagnose where a long workflow fails, recent harnesses deliberately show the judge more than the video-the agent's execution trace, its plan, the narration it synthesized. We ask whether this auxiliary text moves the judge's verdict on purely \emph{visual} requirements, holding the frames fixed. On a benchmark of 109 generated two-event clip…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了智能体评测中一个隐蔽的偏差来源：评审看得越多，对纯视觉要求的判断反而越不可信。
items.why_en: It exposes a hidden bias in agentic evaluation: the more context a judge sees, the less trustworthy its verdict on purely visual criteria becomes.

items.title_zh: DEEPO：用双熵增强策略优化缓解多模态大模型幻觉
items.title_en: DEEPO: Dual-Entropy Enhanced Policy Optimization for Hallucination in MLLMs
items.summary_zh: 强化学习被广泛用于提升多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的推理能力，但其对幻觉的影响并不稳定。作者把原因追溯到“奖励到参数更新”这条纠正链上的两个薄弱环节。在采样层面，语义熵高的困难问题常常产生整组一致错误的样本，使组内相对优势恰好坍缩为零——而这里正是幻觉风险最高的地方。在优化层面，模型“自信但错误”的 token 对梯度几乎不可见。针对这两点，论文提出双熵增强策略优化 DEEPO，试图在采样与优化两端同时修复这条纠正链，从而更有效地抑制多模态幻觉。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28570v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to sharpen reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its effect on hallucination is uneven. We trace this to two weak points in the \emph{correction chain} from reward to parameter update. At the rollout level, hard queries---those with high semantic entropy---frequently produce unanimously wrong sample groups, collapsing the group-relative advantage to zero exactly where hallucination risk is highest. At the optimization level, confident-but-wrong tokens are gradient-invisible: a cate…
items.why_zh: 它指出了强化学习对齐中“优势坍缩”与“自信错误不可见”两个关键漏洞，为降低多模态幻觉提供了新思路。
items.why_en: It identifies two key holes in RL alignment—advantage collapse and gradient-invisible confident errors—offering a new route to reducing multimodal hallucinations.

items.title_zh: BRFID：面向拜占庭鲁棒性的联邦入侵检测
items.title_en: BRFID: Toward Byzantine-Robust Federated Intrusion Detection
items.summary_zh: 论文研究联邦入侵检测系统（IDS）在恶意客户端攻击下的脆弱性。实验显示，在三客户端联邦 IDS 中，单个拜占庭客户端通过标签翻转的模型投毒，把 60% 训练标签翻转后，攻击者自身的检测准确率反而从无投毒时的 99.96% 降到 84.33%，说明这类投毒具有自损性。而联邦全局集成模型在所有测试的投毒率下仍保持稳定准确率——前提是没有部署防御机制，且攻击者之间没有协同。基于这些实证结果，作者提出 BRFID，旨在为联邦入侵检测构建具有拜占庭鲁棒性的方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28599v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Flipping 60\% of training labels from a single Byzantine client using label-flipping model poisoning self-degrades an attacker's own federated detection accuracy, $99.96\%$ (at no poisoning rate) to $84.33\%$ in a three-client federated IDS. Where the Federated global ensemble maintains stable accuracy across all tested poison rates, without a defense mechanism in place and without coordination between attackers. In this paper, we present empirical results quantifying the impact of label-flipping poisoning attacks on a three-client federated ID…
items.why_zh: 它用实证数据刻画了联邦入侵检测中的投毒风险与现有集成的盲区，并提出针对性的鲁棒性方案。
items.why_en: It empirically characterizes poisoning risk and blind spots in federated intrusion detection, and proposes a targeted Byzantine-robust approach.

items.title_zh: HClimRep-Ocean：基于非结构网格的全球海洋模拟器
items.title_en: HClimRep-Ocean: A Global Ocean Emulator on an Unstructured Mesh
items.summary_zh: 近年来，机器学习大气模拟器发展迅速并改变了天气预报，而海洋方向的早期 ML 预报模型虽已出现，成熟度仍明显落后于大气。原因之一在于海洋与大气结构差异显著：海洋的大部分动能储存在中尺度涡旋中，其特征空间尺度约为同类大气现象的一个数量级更小。此外，复杂的海岸线、狭窄海峡与冰封海域也让边界处理变得困难。针对这些挑战，作者提出 HClimRep-Ocean——一个构建在非结构网格上的全球海洋模拟器，试图以更适合海洋几何特征的网格结构来提升海洋模拟能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28601v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine-learning (ML) emulators for atmospheric processes have advanced rapidly in recent years, transforming weather forecasting. Although early ML ocean forecasting models now exist, they remain less developed than their atmospheric counterparts. Unlike the atmosphere, much of the ocean's kinetic energy resides in mesoscale eddies whose characteristic spatial scales are approximately an order of magnitude smaller than those of comparable atmospheric features. Moreover, complex coastlines, narrow straits, and ice-covered seas make boundary rep…
items.why_zh: 它针对海洋中尺度涡旋与复杂边界这一独特难题，把 ML 模拟器的能力从大气推进到全球海洋。
items.why_en: It extends ML emulation from the atmosphere to the global ocean, tackling the distinctive challenges of mesoscale eddies and complex boundaries.

items.title_zh: UltraBench 2：面向超声视觉基础模型的稳健评测基准
items.title_en: UltraBench 2: Towards Robust Evaluation of Vision Foundation Models on Ultrasound
items.summary_zh: 基准测试在机器学习及其医疗等应用领域中愈发关键。然而，尽管近年超声基础模型不断涌现，用于评估它们的精心设计的基准却明显滞后。这一缺失导致不同模型之间的评测零散且标准不一，难以衡量真实进展。为填补这一空白，作者提出 UltraBench 2，一个覆盖广泛解剖部位与任务类型的综合性超声评测基准，旨在为超声视觉基础模型提供更稳健、更一致的评估方式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28610v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Benchmarking is an increasingly critical part of research in machine learning and the domains where it is applied, including healthcare. Yet, despite the steady development of new ultrasound foundation models in recent years, the development of well-designed benchmarks to evaluate them has lagged behind. This deficiency has led to fragmented and inconsistent evaluations of competing models, making it difficult to measure progress. To address this issue, we introduce UltraBench 2, a comprehensive benchmark with wide anatomical and task coverage,…
items.why_zh: 统一的评测基准是衡量超声基础模型真实进展的前提，UltraBench 2 有望结束各自为战的碎片化比较。
items.why_en: A shared benchmark is a precondition for measuring real progress, and UltraBench 2 could end fragmented, incomparable ultrasound model evaluations.

items.title_zh: 奖励黑客挑战自主科研智能体的监督机制
items.title_en: Reward Hacking Challenges Oversight of Autonomous Research Agents
items.summary_zh: 自主科研智能体能够设计实验、评估结果并撰写报告，这意味着它们同时掌控了科学结论与其支撑证据，由此带来“奖励黑客”风险：满足奖励标准却未真正达成预期目标。论文围绕三个问题展开研究：模型在没有被指示的情况下多频繁地发生奖励黑客行为；当被允许作弊时，其手段有多有效、多容易被察觉；以及当 LLM 评审小组给出裁决与理由后，它们会如何调整策略。作者在 17 个语言模型和 38 项任务上进行了系统实验，揭示出自主科研智能体监督中亟待解决的漏洞。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28614v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Autonomous research agents can design experiments, evaluate results, and write reports, giving them control over both a scientific result and the evidence used to support it. This creates a risk of reward hacking: meeting the reward criteria without achieving the intended goal. We study (1) how often models reward-hack without instructions to do so, (2) how effective and detectable their methods are when hacking is allowed, and (3) how they adapt when an LLM review panel returns its decision and reasons. Across 17 language models and 38 tasks,…
items.why_zh: 当 AI 同时掌握结论与证据时，科研诚信的监督机制正面临根本性挑战，这项研究量化了风险。
items.why_en: When AI controls both results and evidence, scientific oversight faces a fundamental challenge—this work quantifies that risk.

items.title_zh: 检索的远征：让小模型学会“下一步检索动作”
items.title_en: The Fellowship of the Query: Learning Retrieval Actions
items.summary_zh: 检索增强问答需要一系列控制决策：何时拆解问题、发起检索、重写查询、抽取证据、归纳事实、验证进展以及停止。论文研究轨迹微调能否让小语言模型（SLM）胜任“下一步动作控制器”，并额外评估了一种低资源设定——由同一个 SLM 同时充当控制器和最终答案生成器。作者从被接受的教师检索轨迹中构建了一个七类动作预测任务，让模型预测下一个结构化动作。这项工作探索了在有限算力与数据条件下，用轨迹学习提升检索式问答控制能力的可行性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28653v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Retrieval-augmented question answering requires control decisions about when to decompose a question, search, reformulate, extract evidence, synthesize facts, verify progress, and stop. We study whether trajectory fine-tuning can improve small language models (SLMs) as next-action controllers. We additionally evaluate a low-resource setting in which a single SLM serves as both the controller and the final-answer generator. From accepted teacher search traces, we build a seven-way action-prediction task, where the model predicts the next structu…
items.why_zh: 它探索用小型模型承担检索式问答的决策控制，为低资源下构建高效 RAG 智能体提供了可行路径。
items.why_en: It explores small models as retrieval control policies, offering a viable path to efficient RAG agents under low-resource constraints.

items.title_zh: 气动扰动下空中连续体机械臂的末端位置时序学习估计
items.title_en: Temporal Learning for End-Effector Position Estimation under Aerodynamic Disturbances in Aerial Continuum Manipulation
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究空中连续体机械臂（ACM）在无人机气动效应影响下的末端执行器位置估计，采用时序神经网络进行建模。作者采集了实验数据集，覆盖转子关闭（静止）与自由悬停两种条件，并遍历不同连续体机器人（CR）构型与无人机飞行高度，从而获得含与不含气动残差的末端位置测量。研究以应变参数化运动学作为标称框架，用以对照学习模型在气动干扰下的表现。这项工作为空中连续体操作的精确控制提供了数据基础与方法参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28716v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper investigates temporal neural networks for \mbox{end-effector} position \mbox{estimation} of an aerial continuum manipulator (ACM) operating under aerodynamic effects induced by the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). An experimental dataset is collected under stationary (\mbox{rotor-off}) and \mbox{free-hovering} conditions across continuum robot (CR) configurations and UAV altitudes, providing \mbox{end-effector} position measurements with and without aerodynamic residuals. To establish a nominal framework, \mbox{strain-parameterized} ki…
items.why_zh: 气动扰动下的末端位姿估计是空中连续体机械臂稳定操作的前提，该研究提供了相应数据集与建模范式。
items.why_en: Accurate end-effector estimation under aerodynamic disturbance is a prerequisite for controlling aerial continuum manipulators, and this work supplies both data and a learning framework.

items.title_zh: 高维高斯线性赌博机中的精确贝叶斯遗憾与渐近最优性
items.title_en: Exact Bayes Regret and Asymptotic Optimality in High-Dimensional Gaussian Bandits
items.summary_zh: 本文研究贝叶斯线性赌博机：参数服从各向同性高斯分布，候选臂相互独立且为高斯，奖励噪声同样为高斯，且时间跨度与维度成正比。作者证明归一化后验不确定性存在显式极限，且该极限在所有因果策略上一致；借助高斯后验恒等式，无需假设自适应递推的闭合性即可确定极限参数重叠。由此得到 Thompson 采样、后验均值贪心选择以及一族随规模缩放的策略的精确遗憾曲线。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28718v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study Bayesian linear bandits with an isotropic Gaussian parameter, independent Gaussian candidate arms, and Gaussian reward noise when the horizon is proportional to the dimension. The normalized posterior uncertainty has an explicit limit that is uniform over all causal policies. Gaussian posterior identities then determine the limiting parameter overlaps without an assumed closure of the adaptive recursion. These results yield exact regret curves for Thompson sampling, posterior-mean greedy selection, and a family of policies that scale t…
items.why_zh: 该结果为高维贝叶斯线性赌博机给出精确遗憾刻画，明确了常用策略的渐近最优性。
items.why_en: It provides exact regret characterization and asymptotic optimality for widely used algorithms in the high-dimensional bandit regime.

items.title_zh: 揭示 IoT 入侵检测中的捷径学习：特征依赖与数据泄漏的多范式取证评估
items.title_en: Unmasking Shortcut Learning in IoT Intrusion Detection: A Forensic, Multi-Paradigm Evaluation of Feature Dependence and Data Leakage
items.summary_zh: 基于机器学习的网络入侵检测系统在 IoT 基准上常报告近乎完美的性能，但这些模型学到的是可泛化的攻击行为，还是诸如测试床固定 IP/MAC 地址、按时间顺序记录造成的伪相关等数据集捷径，仍是一个重要问题。作者对 CyberFlowIoT-GICAP 基准展开评估，该基准包含 126 个 PCAP 会话、共 3,617,388 条流记录，其中良性流 849,395 条。研究在四种特征配置下比较了四种学习范式，并采用 PCAP 级划分以检验特征依赖与数据泄漏（摘要在此截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28725v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning-based Network Intrusion Detection Systems often report near-perfect performance on IoT benchmarks. However, whether these models learn generalizable attack behavior or exploit spurious dataset shortcuts- such as static testbed IP/MAC addresses and chronological recording artifacts-remains an important question. We evaluate the CyberFlowIoT-GICAP benchmark, containing 3,617,388 flow records across 126 PCAP sessions with 849,395 benign flows. Four learning paradigms are evaluated across four feature configurations using PCAP-disj…
items.why_zh: 该研究直指 IoT 入侵检测评测中普遍存在的虚高性能问题，提醒社区警惕捷径学习与数据泄漏。
items.why_en: It exposes how shortcut learning and data leakage can inflate IoT intrusion-detection results, warning against over-trusting near-perfect scores.

items.title_zh: M$^2$PFN：面向阿尔茨海默病可泛化多模态上下文学习的端到端解耦对齐
items.title_en: M$^2$PFN: End-to-End Disentangled Alignment for Generalizable Multimodal In-Context Learning in Alzheimer's Disease
items.summary_zh: 结合影像与表格数据诊断阿尔茨海默病（AD）的多模态方法已有不少，但往往难以跨队列泛化。上下文学习（ICL）在 TabPFN 等基础表格模型中展现出优异的泛化能力与灵活性，然而要把 TabPFN 的 ICL 扩展到多模态 AD 分析，主要障碍在于 TabPFN 是在合成表格先验上元训练的，与影像衍生特征的统计结构并不匹配。为此作者提出 M$^2$PFN，通过端到端解耦对齐解决这一不匹配问题（摘要在此截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28836v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While various multimodal methods combining imaging and tabular data for Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis were proposed, they are often limited in generalization across cohorts. In-context learning (ICL) has demonstrated excellent generalization performances and high flexibility in foundational tabular models such as TabPFN. To extend TabPFN's ICL to multimodal AD analysis, the main obstacle is that TabPFN is meta-trained on synthetic tabular priors that do not naturally match the statistical structure of image-derived features. We propose M$^…
items.why_zh: 该工作尝试把强表格基础模型的上下文学习能力迁移到多模态医学诊断，以缓解跨队列泛化难题。
items.why_en: It aims to transfer the strong in-context learning generalization of tabular foundation models to multimodal clinical diagnosis.

items.title_zh: 不确定性门控探索噪声抑制流匹配 VLA 策略在线强化学习微调中的任务坍塌
items.title_en: Uncertainty-Gated Exploration Noise Suppresses Task Collapse in Online RL Fine-Tuning of a Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policy
items.summary_zh: 对预训练流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略做在线强化学习微调，有望让机器人在部署后持续学习，但持续更新常会破坏单个任务上的能力，而整体指标看起来仍然正常。作者研究这种失败模式并称之为“任务坍塌”，在 LIBERO-10 上于受控的小算力预算下，用 PPO 配合随机（SDE）采样微调 450M 参数的 SmolVLA 策略。实验比较了三种探索噪声策略，其唯一变量是噪声尺度，包括固定噪声尺度等（摘要在此截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28838v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Online reinforcement learning fine-tuning of pretrained flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) policies promises robots that keep learning after deployment, but continued updates often destroy competence on individual tasks while the aggregate still looks healthy. We study this failure mode, which we call task collapse, under a matched small-compute budget on LIBERO-10 with a 450M-parameter SmolVLA policy trained by PPO with stochastic (SDE) sampling. Three exploration-noise policies differ in one live variable: a fixed noise scale, a ReinF…
items.why_zh: 任务坍塌是在线 RL 微调 VLA 时容易被忽视的隐患，该研究提出了基于不确定性门控噪声的缓解思路。
items.why_en: It identifies a hidden risk in continual RL fine-tuning of robot policies and offers uncertainty-gated noise as a mitigation.

items.title_zh: 面向语言引导医学图像分割的多模态路由与区域精修
items.title_en: Multimodal Routing and Region Refinement for Language-Guided Medical Image Segmentation
items.summary_zh: 文本描述可以通过指明需要勾画的病灶及其位置来降低医学图像分割的歧义。现有文本引导方法主要改进图像与语言特征的交互位置，但通常对所有图文对沿用同一条学习到的更新路径。作者提出 MRSeg，一个参数高效的框架：在密集预测之前，利用每个图文对来路由视觉与文本特征的适配方式。其视觉与文本编码器分别采用冻结的 ConvNeXt-Tiny 与 PubMedBERT，提供多尺度视觉特征与临床文本表示（摘要在此截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28860v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Textual descriptions can reduce ambiguity in medical image segmentation by specifying the finding and location to be delineated. Existing text-guided methods mainly improve where image and language features interact but generally retain a single learned update pathway across all image-text pairs. We propose MRSeg, a parameter-efficient framework that uses each image-text pair to route the adaptation of visual and textual features before dense prediction. Frozen ConvNeXt-Tiny and PubMedBERT encoders provide multiscale visual features and clinica…
items.why_zh: 该框架以参数高效的方式实现图文对级别的自适应路由，有助于提升语言引导医学分割的灵活性与精度。
items.why_en: Pair-specific routing offers a parameter-efficient way to make language-guided medical segmentation more adaptive and accurate.

items.title_zh: Forecast-Dojo：用于评测与训练 LLM 预测智能体的可回放环境
items.title_en: Forecast-Dojo: Replayable Environments for Benchmarking and Training LLM Forecasting Agents
items.summary_zh: 作者推出 Forecast-Dojo，一个可回放的环境，用于评测和训练大语言模型预测智能体。它把已有结果的预测市场问题与带日期的新闻结合起来，让智能体研究某一事件，并在随后的历史日期上反复修正其预测。同一套任务与工具可用于重复评测、收集训练交互，并借助已记录的结果提供反馈，而无需等待新事件结算。Forecast-Dojo 包含 1,568 个 Polymarket 事件，并按时间划分为训练期与评测期（摘要在此截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28876v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Forecast-Dojo, a replayable environment for benchmarking and training LLM forecasting agents. It combines resolved prediction-market questions with dated news, allowing agents to research an event and revisit their predictions at successive historical dates. The same tasks and tools support repeated evaluation, collection of training interactions, and feedback from recorded outcomes without waiting for new events to resolve. Forecast-Dojo contains 1,568 Polymarket events, split by time into training and evaluation periods, and 18.8…
items.why_zh: 可回放的历史预测环境让 LLM 预测智能体的训练与评测变得可重复，且无需等待真实事件结算。
items.why_en: Replayable history makes LLM forecasting agents cheap to evaluate and train without waiting for real-world outcomes.

items.title_zh: 面向硬件设计验证的自动工装进化：LLM 能否整合已发现工装的收益？
items.title_en: Automatic Harness Evolution for Hardware Design Verification: Can LLMs Consolidate Gains Across Discovered Harnesses?
items.summary_zh: 智能体行为取决于围绕语言模型的“工装”（harness），但语言模型能否在硬件设计任务中可靠地改进这类工装仍不清楚。作者在 12 个专有的设计验证根因定位任务上，围绕一个固定的被评估模型研究自动工装进化。每个任务进行五次试验，自动进化出的工装使完成的尝试数提升 71%–76%，任一命中的任务覆盖率提升 80%–100%，但总正确尝试数仅提升 18%–24%；最强的可复现成功至少……（摘要在此截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.28908v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agent behavior depends on the harness surrounding a language model, but it remains unclear whether language models can reliably improve such harnesses for hardware-design tasks. We study automatic harness evolution around a fixed subject model on 12 proprietary design-verification root-cause localization tasks. Across five trials per task, automatically evolved harnesses increased completed attempts by 71-76% and any-hit task coverage by 80-100%, while total correct attempts improved by only 18-24%. The strongest success reproducible at least t…
items.why_zh: 该研究显示自动工装进化能显著提升覆盖率与尝试量，但正确率实际增益有限，提醒不要被表面指标迷惑。
items.why_en: It shows harness evolution can inflate coverage and attempt counts while delivering only modest gains in actual correctness.
